scope: Fresh same-movement-plane hip/knee/ankle/toe audit of current run/S, run/SE and run/SW, 48 formal frames
criterion: Support and swing feet must remain in their directional movement plane. Natural sagittal knee/ankle flexion and depth foreshortening are allowed; toes must not yaw sideways relative to the knee/ankle movement plane. Old passed flags are not inspection evidence.
method: All 48 full 1024 formal PNGs were actually viewed individually in sequence.
SE05-08/13-16 and SW05-08/13-16 were additionally compared as a native-scale leg crop contact sheet.

Static observations only; no live playback claimed by this reviewer. Visible hip exits, knees, shin contours, tongue center, heel and forefoot were compared; hidden hip skeleton is not asserted as measurable ground truth.

confirmedRepairList.screenLocation: rear support boot at lower screen right
confirmedRepairList.issue: Left rear support shin reaches toward screen right, but the boot tongue and toe turn almost straight down/S. Compared with SW05 and SW07/08, the SW component disappears and returns, creating an isolated support-foot yaw change.
confirmedRepairList.recommendedCorrection: Locally restore a SW left/down boot toe and ankle connection using adjacent SW support-foot yaw; preserve existing hip, knee, rear support contact location, opposite leg and entire upper body. Do not copy a neighbor or shift/scale the whole frame.

preserveNotes: S: all 16 support shoes keep frontal S facing; forward soles face the viewer as expected.
SE: rear support boots are shorter in projection, but heel-to-forefoot contour remains toward right/down; no sufficiently clear independent yaw error found in this pass.
SW14/15 were specifically rechecked: rear shoes are relatively frontal but retain the toe left of heel; no confirmed defect as strong as SW06.
No formal PNG or shared manifest/review/contact/status file was edited.
